adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent`, the fallback logic was changed from using `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null` (the common “no explicit externalCalendarId” case), the `find` predicate compares against `undefined`/`null` and returns `undefined`, so `selectedCalendar` becomes `undefined`. The subsequent `calendar.events.update` uses `calendarId: selectedCalendar` (no `|| "primary"` shown in the diff for update), which would send `calendarId: undefined` and cause the update to fail. This is a behavior regression from the previous fallback to the destination calendar externalId.
